closure: Full author mathematical body retained. Exact Theorem1.1 statement194–202 and full hyperbola-method proof816–1385 are preserved with PropertyI, exponent region, every newly necessary polyhedral/lattice-counting lemma and small-coordinate boundary estimates. The maximal face is expressly not contained in a coordinate hyperplane; no omitted general-face claim is selected. Classical Davenport lattice counting and elementary exponential sums remain cited foundations. All later arithmetic-geometric applications are unselected context, not extra corpus claims.
current_difficulty_reason: The usual one-constraint hyperbola identity does not count boxes in a general polytope or control small-coordinate regions under box PropertyI alone. The authors prove volume and coordinate-projection bounds near the maximizing face, approximate weighted slice counts by lattice counting and separate dyadic interior and boundary contributions. This new polyhedral decomposition yields both the exact leading constant and the logarithmic saving without the stronger lower-dimensional-box assumption, beyond merely applying Davenport's lemma.
